item.title: Trevor Noah: Daily Social Distancing Show
item.description:
Funny Comments

Clip: The 1918 Spanish Flu vs. COVID-19. Spot the difference

  • History Doesn’t Repeat Itself, but it Often Rhymes.

  • Stupidity isn’t a disease but it sure is spreading like one.

  • The more I learn about humans, the more I like my dog.

  • Those who do not learn history are doomed to repeat it.

  • History taught us that we can’t learn anything from history.

  • Fun fact: The spanish flu started in the United States of America, but due to the fact that Spain was the first country to adress it, the rest of the world call it spanish flu.

Q: What has America learned since the 1918 flu?
Me : that we're idiots

  • Stupidity has some allies though, arrogance and agenda. Good luck to US!

  • Trump has infected millions with his ignorance, stupidity, and lies! He has been a disaster for the country!

  • It is also an pandemic of anti-intellectualism.

Clip: Trump's Brutal Interview with Chris Wallace

  • It’s hard to win an argument with a smart person, but it’s damn near impossible to win an argument with a stupid person.

  • “I’ll be right eventually” is like saying a broken clock is right twice a day.

  • Where ignorance is his master, there is no possibility of real peace.

  • Trump finally got his wall. But it’s not at the border!

  • Trump Has Imprisoned Himself in the White House. The president is trying to project strength, but instead is betraying weakness.

  • It’s like listening to a toddler tell a story. You know there’s a boat involved and you understand individual words, but the story itself is gibberish.
